item.title: Puyuan Fashion Ancient Town — ¥499 (≈$70): Fujin Hotel Night + Breakfast + Ancient Town Entry & Autumn Art Events
item.description:
Deal price: ¥499 (≈$70, was ¥670) · ⏰ Valid through at least Dec 20, 2026 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends or public holidays

Puyuan Fashion Ancient Town in Tongxiang, Jiaxing is running its autumn “Puyuan Weaves Autumn” program (Oct 15–Dec 20): the whole town becomes an open-air art exhibition — tea ceremonies, calligraphy, meditation, 30+ live performances a day, plus the CPOP WAVE 2026 pop-culture expo (Nov 2–8) with big-name game and animation IPs. This bundle pairs a night at the Fujin Hotel with breakfast, 2 adult ancient-town tickets, the art exhibitions, and free sightseeing shuttle rides around the town.

item.title: Qiandaohu Powei Yiqu Resort from ¥299 (≈$42)/Night with 3 Daily Meals — Autumn 4-Night Bundle ¥699
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥299/night (≈$42, was ¥899) · ⏰ Valid through Jan 1, 2027 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends or New Year’s Day · ⏰ Limited free upgrade to family/parent-child rooms

The Powei Yiqu Resort is French group Pierre & Vacances’ (太阳季) brand-new resort in Qiandaohu’s Alpha City — a futuristic island-style complex of four modern buildings on the Pearl Peninsula, where most rooms come with private balconies facing the lake. Dining covers several restaurants serving local Qiandaohu cuisine, and the resort packs in a kids’ park, water world, gym, chess rooms and table tennis. The headline bundle: 4 nights with 3 meals a day for ¥699 — a stay where you never have to think about where to eat.

item.title: Shanghai Teddy Bear Jungle Park — ¥69 (≈$10): 9 Play Zones, Kids' Theater, LEGO Tables & DIY Crafts
item.description:
Deal price: ¥69 (≈$10, was ¥109) for 1 adult + 1 child · ⏰ Valid Wed–Sun through Nov 30, 2026

Straight from Korea’s Jeju Teddy Bear Museum, the Teddy Bear Jungle Park has landed in Shanghai’s AMP Plaza — a teddy-filled indoor playground where every corner is stuffed with plush bears and painted jungle scenes. The 9 play zones include a kids’ theater with regular interactive games, jungle slides, interactive projection games, LEGO building tables, and DIY craft workshops (make-your-own keychains to take home). It’s equal parts playdate and photo shoot.

item.title: Suzhou Gulliver Parent-Child Resort Hotel from ¥399 (≈$56): Themed Room + Breakfast + Petting Zoo & Indoor Kids' Park
item.description:
Deal price: ¥399 (≈$56, was ¥499) · ⏰ Valid through Jan 1, 2027 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends or New Year’s Day

Inside the Jiangnan Botanical Garden on the shores of Taihu Lake, the Suzhou Gulliver Parent-Child Resort Hotel turns Gulliver’s Travels into a place to sleep. Instead of “child-friendly,” the whole resort is built for kids: oversized furniture seen through the eyes of Lilliput’s tiny residents, hidden proportion-play surprises in the corridors, and a garden landscape that makes adults feel finger-sized. Every stay includes the DuoDuo petting zoo, the indoor kids’ park, and free access to the botanical garden (which also has a small zoo).

item.title: Xiamen Marco Polo Buffet — ¥138 (≈$19)/Person: Steamed Seafood, Unlimited Sashimi & the Famous Napoleon Pastry
item.description:
Deal price: ¥1,380 for 10 — works out to ¥138/person (≈$19, was ¥198) · ⏰ Valid through Jan 31, 2027 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends or public holidays

The Marco Polo Oriental Hotel’s buffet has been a Xiamen landmark for over 20 years, and in Xiamen “Marco Polo” is practically shorthand for its Napoleon pastry — the flaky, cream-layered signature that fans come back for again and again. The spread runs to a hundred-plus dishes: steamed seafood (shrimp, mussels, oysters, scallops, clams — picked fresh and steamed to order), unlimited sashimi from the hotel’s own Japanese restaurant chefs, a teppanyaki grill station, and every lunch guest gets a complimentary Buddha Jumps Over the Wall (佛跳墙) soup. Each adult may bring one child under 1.2m free.

item.title: Guangzhou Phoenix City Hotel ¥499 (≈$70): 1 Night + Breakfast & Dinner for 2 Adults + 1 Kid, No Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: ¥499 (≈$70, was ¥1088, about 54% off) · ⏰ Valid Sep 11–Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends, Mid-Autumn Festival or National Day · ⏰ Refundable if unreserved

Inside the Phoenix City (凤凰城) community in Zengcheng, Guangzhou — a garden-style resort hotel next to the Science City area — the Phoenix City Hotel is offering a straightforward family bundle: 1 night in a premium double/twin room, buffet breakfast for 2 adults + 1 kid (under 1.2m), and dinner for 2 adults + 1 kid at either the Vienna western restaurant or the Chinese restaurant. During the stay you also get the indoor swimming pool, the kids’ building-block play zone, and the kids’ water park.

item.title: Qingdao Movie Metropolis DoubleTree from ¥449 (≈$63): 1 Night + Breakfast + Kids' Park or Hotpot Dinner
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥449 (≈$63, was ¥988, about 55% off) · ⏰ Valid through Oct 31, 2026 — only 9 days left · ⏰ Refundable if unreserved

In Qingdao’s Huangdao district, next to the Oriental Movie Metropolis, the DoubleTree by Hilton is running an eat-stay-play bundle: 1 night in a deluxe room (king or twin) with breakfast for two, plus one of five add-on options — from kids’ park tickets to a hotpot dinner. Every stay also includes the famous warm DoubleTree cookie, plus free pool, gym and WiFi during the stay.

item.title: Quanzhou Oulebao Fairyland ¥769 (≈$108): 1 Night Hotel + 2A2C Breakfast + Theme-Park Tickets
item.description:
Deal price: ¥769 (≈$108, was ¥1888, about 59% off) · ⏰ Valid Oct 16–Nov 30, 2026 · ⏰ No surcharge for off-peak weekends · ⏰ Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

On the coast of Hui’an in Quanzhou, Fujian, the Bashian Guohai (Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea) Resort pairs a night at one of two themed hotels with its Fairy Tale World theme park. The bundle covers 1 night in a Eurasia room at the Water Park Hotel (mountain or garden view, assigned) or a Navigator twin / Voyager family / Dreamer family room at the Zheng He Treasure Ship Hotel, buffet breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids (under 1.2m), and Fairy Tale World tickets for 2 adults + 2 kids with unlimited re-entry during the stay.

item.title: Shanghai Brightland Kids' Play Park from ¥59 (≈$8): Dual-Park Card with Four Seasons Ice & Snow World
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥59 (≈$8) · ⏰ Valid Oct 9–Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ Usable on weekends and public holidays, no reservation or ticket exchange needed · ⏰ Refundable anytime

Brightland (耀心岛) is Shanghai’s indoor kids’ play-park chain — climbing structures, slides, ball pits and role-play zones — with branches in Qingpu and at the LCM mall in Pudong. This offer pairs it with the Four Seasons Ice & Snow World (四季冰雪乐园) in Qingpu, so one card covers a play park and a snow park in the same trip.

item.title: Zhangzhou Hot Spring Villa Resort ¥499 (≈$70): 1 Night + Meals + Hot Springs, Flower Expo & Snail Village
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥499 (≈$70, was ¥798, about 37% off) · ⏰ Buy now, valid for use Nov 1–30, 2026 · ⏰ Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

In Zhangpu county, Zhangzhou, Fujian, the Southeast Flower Capital Hot Spring Hotel sits next to the Flower Expo park — an autumn family trip that bundles a villa-style stay with hot springs and two parks. Every package includes 1 night, buffet breakfast for 2 adults + 1 kid (under 1.4m), a kids’ set meal or wellness set meal (pick one), hot-spring entry for 2A1C, Flower Expo tickets for 2A1C, and Snail Village tickets for 2A1C.

item.title: Anji Moroccan-Style Art Resort ¥399 (≈$56): 2-Day Unlimited Elf Hill Tickets + Breakfast
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥399 (≈$56, was ¥999, about 60% off) · 2-night bundle ¥629 − ¥30 coupon = ¥599 · ⏰ 1-week flash sale · Valid through Jan 31, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Inside Anji’s Hele Valley resort zone — between the Bamboo Museum and Lingfeng Mountain, 1.5h from Hangzhou and 2h from Shanghai — the Xingcheng Moroccan-Style Art Resort trades the usual bamboo aesthetic for something completely different: a high-design, gallery-like hotel wrapped in Moroccan romance. The bundle pairs the stay with 2 Elf Hill tickets with 2-day unlimited re-entry and daily breakfast for 2 adults + 1 kid, plus the valley’s activity program.

item.title: Shanghai Yaoxue Ski + Ice-Snow Hotel ¥799 (≈$112): 2 Beginner Slope Tickets + Hot Spring + 1 Night
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥799 (≈$112, was ¥1,598, about 50% off) · Valid through Dec 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Shanghai’s Yaoxue Ice & Snow World — a ~350,000㎡ indoor winter resort with a 98,000㎡+ real-snow slope — is the rare ski trip that needs no mountain. This Double-11 bundle pairs 2 beginner-slope 3-hour tickets (the kids’ snow zone on level 3 is the family sweet spot: snow-tube runs, igloo engineers, rainbow snow village) with a hot-spring session, 1 night in a superior room at the partnering Lingang Ice-Snow Mingcheng Hotel (walkable to the slopes), and breakfast for two. Weekends are usable with a surcharge.

item.title: Wuhan Kaiyuan Senbo Resort ¥599 (≈$84): Garden-View Room + Water Park or Fantasy Island Tickets
item.description:
Deal price: Superior garden-view room, 1 night — ¥599 (≈$84, was ¥1,298, about 54% off) · Valid through Mar 31, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Rising on a peninsula in Houguan Lake, the Wuhan Kaiyuan Senbo Resort is a ¥2.2-billion, 128,000㎡ all-season family resort — and this Double-11 bundle is its strongest value yet. One price covers a superior garden-view room, breakfast for two, your choice of 2 indoor-water-park or 2 Fantasy Island tickets, and a Yiqi travel-photography session. Weekends carry no surcharge through the whole validity period.

item.title: Xiamen Baixiang Portman Seven Star Bay ¥899 (≈$126): 2 Nights + Buffet Dinner & Breakfast
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥899 (≈$126, was ¥2,399, about 63% off) · Headline 2-night bundle ¥1,299 · Valid through Apr 30, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

“Apart from the price, there’s nothing wrong with it” — that’s the running verdict on the Xiamen Baixiang Portman, and at these Double-11 rates the price objection mostly evaporates. The resort does palace-scale grandeur properly: manicured grounds, a proper beach within reach, and service reviewers call out by name. The headline bundle covers 2 nights in a superior room, a weekday buffet dinner for two, daily buffet breakfast, and 2 mini-club activities for the kids. Autumn holidays and weekends carry no surcharge.

item.title: Xiamen Haiyue Shanzhuang ¥899 (≈$126): Family Mountain-View Twin Room + Breakfast + Kids Activities
item.description:
Deal price: Family mountain-view twin room, 1 night — ¥899 (≈$126, was ¥1,488, about 40% off) · Valid through Apr 30, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Set in landscaped gardens on Huandao South Road — the back gate opens straight onto the beach — Haiyue Shanzhuang is the old-school Xiamen grande dame: state-guesthouse standards, Ming-Qing-style rooms in a bamboo courtyard, and grounds big enough to spend two days in. This family bundle covers a mountain-view twin room, breakfast for two plus a free kids’ breakfast (no height limit), a pony-cart or mini-train ride, and access to the dolphin park, indoor pool and afternoon tea. New Year holidays and weekends carry no surcharge.

item.title: Disney 100 Years of Wonder Exhibition — China Premiere in Beijing (from ¥108)
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥108 (≈$15) (was ¥188 — up to 43% off) · ¥3 off orders ¥100+ · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

The China premiere of Disney 100 Years of Wonder is now open at Beijing Chaoyang Joy City (10F): a walk-through century of Disney magic drawn from the Walt Disney Archives — original props and costumes, the glass slipper, Marvel artifacts, BB-8, immersive music-and-story galleries and a cinema-style finale hall. Buy-and-use tickets (no exchange needed): book through the exhibition’s WeChat account and enter with your booking QR plus purchase QR.

item.title: Gubei Light Resort Beijing from ¥1,099 (≈$153): Gubei Water Town + Hot Spring + Great Wall Cableway
item.description:
Deal price: Superior room, 1 night — ¥1,099 (≈$153, was ¥1,550, about 29% off) · Valid Oct 22 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved

The Gubei Light Resort sits in the prime “C-position” of Gubei Water Town, the canal town beneath the Simatai Great Wall — and this package bundles the whole experience: 2 water-town scenic-area tickets, 2 hot-spring tickets, plus your choice of a Great Wall day or night tour with round-trip cableway or a dinner for two (3 options to pick from). Weekend stays are possible with a surcharge, so this works for a Saturday escape too.

item.title: Huian Julong Hot Spring Resort ¥488 (≈$68): Private Hot-Spring Room + Unlimited Soaking for 2 Adults & 2 Kids
item.description:
Deal price: Private hot-spring room, 1 night — ¥488 (≈$68, was ¥828, about 41% off) · Valid Sep 23 – Dec 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Tucked inside the Julong eco-park in Huian, Quanzhou, the Julong Hot Spring Park Hotel pairs a private in-room hot-spring tub with unlimited access to the hot-spring park for your whole stay. This one-price package covers 2 adults + 2 kids (under 1.4m): breakfast, unlimited soaking, and the Pinecone Tribe kids’ play zone — plus a free shuttle and free parking. Weekends carry no surcharge.

item.title: Sanya Bay voco 2-Night Stay from ¥1,288 (≈$179): IHG Beachfront + Breakfast for 2 Adults & 2 Kids
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights, superior king/twin with balcony — ¥1,288 (≈$179, was ¥1,888, about 32% off) · Valid Aug 29 – Nov 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

voco Sanya Bay — the IHG brand’s easygoing beachfront address on Sanya Bay — is running an off-peak island escape: a balcony room for 2 nights, breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids (under 1.4m), a fresh-coconut welcome for two, first-day minibar, and a stack of on-property perks. Check-in is a relaxed 16:00, checkout noon.

item.title: Xiamen Langham Hotel from ¥699 (≈$97): 40㎡ Art-Hotel Room + Breakfast, No Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: Superior king/twin, 1 night + breakfast for two — ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥1,198, about 42% off) · Valid Oct 15 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

The Langham Hotel Xiamen — the Langham Hospitality Group’s art-forward address in Huli, steps from the Wanda Plaza shopping district — is on limited flash sale: a 40㎡ superior room with breakfast for two and free parking, and notably no weekend surcharge. Check-in 14:00, checkout noon.

item.title: Xiamen Lingling Halloween from ¥59 (≈$8): Animal Kingdom + Award-Winning Circus Show
item.description:
Deal price: Animal Kingdom ticket — ¥59 (≈$8, was ¥140, about 42% of list) · Valid Oct 17 – Nov 29, 2026, weekends only · ⏰ refundable anytime, auto-refund on expiry

Xiamen Lingling is going full Halloween this autumn: the Animal Kingdom (giant pandas plus animals from five continents) opens for afternoon entry, and the award-winning Lingling circus performs at 18:30 — a stage show built on acrobatics rather than animal acts. Buy now, use on any Saturday or Sunday through Nov 29 — no ticket exchange needed, just show your voucher code.

item.title: Qiandaohu 3-Night All-Meals Stay from ¥239 (≈$33): JunTing Hotel by Central Lake
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 3 buffet meals for two — ¥239 (≈$33, was ¥666, about 36% of list) · Valid Sep 8 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved

The JunTing Hotel sits on the central-lake “Fish Street” of Qiandaohu (Thousand-Islet Lake), about 20 minutes from the high-speed rail station — and this package is built for slow family travel: a room, three buffet meals a day (breakfast, lunch 11:30–13:00, dinner 17:00–18:30), plus a stack of local freebies. The family room sleeps three (one king + one double bed, 40㎡) with a lake-view twin option, free Wi-Fi, free parking, an outdoor kids playground, ping-pong room and self-service laundry.

item.title: “Golden Soup Passport” Hot-Spring Card ¥168 (≈$23): One Soak Each at 28 Hot Springs Across 9 Provinces
item.description:
Deal price: one soak each at 28 hot springs — ¥168 (≈$23, was ¥1,969, about 9% of list) · Valid May 13 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · ⏰ refundable anytime if unreserved

The “Golden Soup Passport” (金汤护照) is the returning bestseller for hot-spring season: a single ¥168 card covers one visit each at 28 well-known hot-spring resorts across 9 provinces — for families, grandparents, couples, or a team outing stocking up for winter. The card page lists every participating venue (e.g. Chang’anli Hot Spring Hotel in Nantong, Jiangsu); on a few peak dates a venue may ask for a small front-desk top-up, per the venue list.

item.title: Guangzhou Emerald Hilton “Ice BBQ & Beer Festival” Buffet from ¥218 (≈$30): Charcoal Oysters, Thick-Cut Salmon & Free-Flow Drinks
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid lunch buffet — from ¥218 (≈$30, was ¥416, about 53% of list) · Valid Jul 10 – Nov 30, 2026 · weekends only (Sat/Sun), no surcharge · ⏰ refundable anytime if unreserved

The Guangzhou Emerald Hilton (28 Ningcai Road, Science City, Huangpu District) is running its “Ice BBQ & Beer Food Festival” theme buffet: charcoal-grilled oysters, thick-cut salmon, grilled skewers, sliced roast beef and free-flow drinks across the hall. With 40+ vouchers already grabbed, it’s the weekend family table locals are booking right now.

item.title: Suzhou Jiletang Hot Spring Hotel — New Opening from ¥238 (≈$33): Room + Breakfast + 2 Hot-Spring Tickets, Zero Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast for two + 2 hot-spring tickets — ¥238 (≈$33, was ¥999, about 24% of list) · Valid May 21 – Oct 31, 2026 · zero weekend surcharge · ⏰ refundable if unreserved

The brand-new Jiletang Hot Spring Hotel (No. 999 Yangshan Ring Road, Huqiu District, Suzhou) bundles its opening promo the way families actually want it: a room, breakfast for two, and 2 hot-spring tickets per night covering the outdoor thermal pools, the water park, plus free fruit and drinks. Everything is new, the promo price is the draw — and weekends cost nothing extra.

item.title: Anji Cloud Grassland Resort 2 Nights ¥699 (≈$99): Kids' Activities, Free Dress-Up Photos & Egg Collecting
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights + kids’ GO activities + 3 free costume photos per room + farm egg-collecting — ¥699 (≈$99, was ¥988, 29% off) · Valid Oct 7 – Dec 10, 2026 · usable any day of the week · not usable Nov 14–15, 2026

In the bamboo-covered hills of Shanchuan, Anji, the Cloud Grassland (云上草原) resort offers an autumn off-peak escape for families: two nights interchangeable across three hotels (Yunshanjing, Songshu, Yinzhu — +¥200/night upgrades the other two to a basic king/twin), with a packed kids’ program: Family GO activities (handicrafts, clown interactions and more), 3 free costume dress-up photos per room, and egg collecting at the family farm, plus 24-hour butler service.

item.title: Guangzhou Hilton Curio Seafood Buffet 1 Adult + 1 Kid ¥168 (≈$24): Oysters, Sashimi & Free-Flow Drinks
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 kid (under 1.4 m) lunch buffet — ¥168 (≈$24, was ¥308, 45% off) · Valid through Nov 30, 2026 · weekends only (Sat/Sun), no weekend surcharge · ⏰ not usable Oct 17, 18, 24, 25; also closed during the Canton Fair (Oct 16 – Nov 1) — usable again from Nov 5

At Jiangxin Ge (匠心阁) on the 3rd floor of the Curio Collection by Hilton Guangzhou (Yuexiu district, metro-accessible near Beijing Road), the opening-wave pricing covers 1 adult + 1 kid under 1.4 m — note the free-kid height has been raised from 1.2 m to 1.4 m for this promo (limited availability). Lunch runs 12:00–14:30, dinner 18:00–21:30.

item.title: Nanjing Wolonghu Lakeside Resort 2 Nights ¥499 (≈$70): 70㎡ Room, Water Play + Sauna Passes
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights in a 70㎡+ room + breakfast for 2 + water-play & sauna passes for 2 + lakeside cycling — ¥499 (≈$70, was ¥799, 38% of list) · Valid Oct 14, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · usable any day of the week, no weekend surcharge

On Wolonghu Avenue in Nanjing’s Lishui district, this lakeside resort sells space: the 72㎡ deluxe king (2 m bed) or 70㎡ twin, each with breakfast for two, a water-play pass for two — indoor surfing, a flower-sea photo zone, indoor pool, fish-therapy spa and sauna, plus KTV and board-game rooms — and lakeside cycling. Kids under 12 go free; ages 12–16 are ¥29.9 and 16+ ¥39.9.

item.title: Shanghai Swan Lake Manor Autumn Pasture ¥29.9 (≈$4): Capybaras, Deer Forest & No-Power Playground
item.description:
Deal price: single early-bird ticket — ¥29.9 (≈$4, was ¥88, 66% off) · Valid Sep 20 – Nov 22, 2026 · usable any day of the week, no blackout dates · buy-and-use, refundable anytime

At Daqian Swan Lake Manor (1 Xiyangdian Road, Zhujiajiao Town, Qingpu), the autumn pasture program packs a surprising amount into one ticket: 1,000+ black swans, the newly-arrived capybara house, a deer forest, yak and alpaca pastures, dwarf-goat and piglet meadows, a peacock garden and a mini zoo — plus a no-power playground (bouncy cloud, slides, sand pits), stream play, a rose garden and 10,000㎡ of lawn camping spots. Each adult may bring one child under 1 m free.

item.title: Yangzhou Xiaoqinhuai Hotel 2-Night Stay + Heyuan Garden Tickets ¥898 (≈$126)
item.description:
Deal price: deluxe room + breakfast for 2 — ¥458 (≈$65, was ¥655, 30% off) · 2 nights deluxe room + breakfast + 2 Heyuan Garden tickets with guided tour + scenic-boat ride — ¥898 (≈$126) · Valid Oct 15, 2026 – May 31, 2027 · usable any day of the week

Tucked at 89 Renfengli, Wenchang Middle Road in central Yangzhou, the Xiaoqinhuai Hotel pairs its 24–35㎡ deluxe rooms (king or twin) and 42–56㎡ featured suites with the city’s classic sights. The headline bundle covers 2 nights with breakfast, two tickets to Heyuan Garden — one of Yangzhou’s famous private gardens — a guided tour of it, and a boat ride on the Little Qinhuai, plus the first round of the in-room minibar free.
